title: frame
description: One motion-capture frame. Sent by the Python motion producer on Socket.IO namespace /ingest, event 'frame' (up to package_framerate, 240 Hz). The hub overwrites 'timestamp' with its receipt time, attaches the latest audio_metrics as 'audio' when available, and re-emits the result on /viewer, event 'frame'. The same schema validates both hops.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Consumers must reject any other value.

type.description: Source tag. Always 'optitrack', including for simulated motion that stands in for OptiTrack.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch milliseconds. The producer sets its send time; the hub overwrites it with its receipt time (JS Date.now()) before forwarding, so on /viewer it is always hub time. The minimum rejects a value accidentally sent in seconds.

rigidbodies.description: Currently tracked rigid bodies, at most one entry per ID. Order is not significant: consumers must look bodies up by ID, never by array index. A body missing from a frame is not tracked in that frame.

audio.description: Latest audio_metrics message, attached by the hub only. Producers on /ingest never send it; the hub omits it when no audio has arrived (or, once implemented, when it is stale). It keeps its own schemaVersion and always carries the hub 'timestamp'.

rigidBodyFields.$comment: Field definitions shared with splat.schema.json. No additionalProperties here, so that schema can extend it; closed via rigidBody below.
rigidBodyFields.description: State of one rigid body in arena coordinates. Arena axes (D5): right-handed, x and y horizontal, z vertical (up), origin at arena centre on the floor. Positions are millimetres; nominal arena bounds come from cobeart/settings/streaming.py (x and y in [-3000, 3000], z in [0, 2500]) and are not enforced here, because a body slightly outside the arena is a valid observation that consumers clamp. Orientation (D5, provisional pending an on-site check) is a unit quaternion in arena axes, not Euler angles, so it has no gimbal lock or wraparound. At identity the body faces arena +y with up = +z (body right = +x). Consumers derive what they need from it, e.g. forward = q applied to (0, 1, 0), and forward lean = asin(-forward.z), positive leaning forward.

ID.description: Rigid-body ID as assigned in Motive. Canonical name is 'ID' (upper case). The producer only sends IDs below max_num_objects (streaming.py, currently 10); names for IDs are in cobeart-app/public/body_map.json.

x.description: Position along arena x, integer millimetres. Nominal range [-3000, 3000].

y.description: Position along arena y, integer millimetres. Nominal range [-3000, 3000].

z.description: Height above the arena floor (arena z, up), integer millimetres. Nominal range [0, 2500].

qx.description: Orientation quaternion, x component (vector part). The quaternion (qx, qy, qz, qw) is unit length and maps body axes to arena axes as a proper rotation. q and -q are the same orientation: consumers must not rely on the sign.

qy.description: Orientation quaternion, y component (vector part). The quaternion (qx, qy, qz, qw) is unit length and maps body axes to arena axes as a proper rotation. q and -q are the same orientation: consumers must not rely on the sign.

qz.description: Orientation quaternion, z component (vector part). The quaternion (qx, qy, qz, qw) is unit length and maps body axes to arena axes as a proper rotation. q and -q are the same orientation: consumers must not rely on the sign.

qw.description: Orientation quaternion, scalar part (scalar-last order, as in scipy and THREE.js).

vx.description: Velocity along arena x, mm/s (finite difference between successive producer frames).

wx.description: Angular velocity about arena x, degrees/s. The vector (wx, wy, wz) is computed from successive orientation quaternions (rotation vector of q_now * q_prev^-1 over the time step), in arena axes, so it has no spikes at angle wraparound.

wy.description: Angular velocity about arena y, degrees/s. The vector (wx, wy, wz) is computed from successive orientation quaternions (rotation vector of q_now * q_prev^-1 over the time step), in arena axes, so it has no spikes at angle wraparound.

wz.description: Angular velocity about arena z, degrees/s. The vector (wx, wy, wz) is computed from successive orientation quaternions (rotation vector of q_now * q_prev^-1 over the time step), in arena axes, so it has no spikes at angle wraparound.

abs_vel.description: Horizontal speed sqrt(vx^2 + vy^2), mm/s. vz is not included.

norm_abs_vel.description: abs_vel divided by max_vel (13000 mm/s) and capped at 1, then held at the maximum of the recent history window so it decays only after sustained stillness. Dimensionless, [0, 1].
